newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Smithfield raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Smithfield raised to buy.

text.p: --Dain Bosworth Inc said Thursday it raised its rating on Smithfield Foods Inc to a buy from a hold. It also lifted its April 1997 Q4 earnings per share estimate to $0.70 from $0.35.
--Dain said it raised its EPS for full-year FY97 to $2.00 from $1.65 and for FY98 to $3.10 from $2.80.

--As a reason for its action, Dain cited its view that hog disease problems in Taiwan, currently the largest exporter of pork to Japan, are seen as a multi-year opportunity for Smithfield. Its 12-month price target on the stock is $70.
